scientific.label: Elevation
scientific.title: Color shows height above the PDS 561.4 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds shared approximate globe lighting. controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: USGS Cassini/Voyager mosaic, about 154 m per source pixel, downsampled to the shared 8192 × 4096 layout. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows adds approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.notes: Published 2014 enhanced-color composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Colors extend beyond human vision into ultraviolet and infrared. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.

controls.label: Shape
controls.notes: Neutral gray over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Cassini SPC Q128 model released in 2025. The 2,000-face view retains broad shape; small terrain details are omitted. Neutral gray (#808080 sRGB) is a shared display convention, not measured surface color or albedo.

controls.label: Infrared
controls.notes: Cassini VIMS false color: red 2.00 µm, green 1.57 µm, blue 1.06 µm. The archive corrects illumination to incidence 30° and emergence 0°; fixed display ranges are shared with Rhea. One-degree source cells remain visible. Gray grid marks missing spectra. Archive registration is uncertain at about the source-pixel scale; no subdegree positional accuracy is implied.

controls.label: Ice absorption
controls.notes: Strength of the 2.02 µm water-ice absorption relative to a linear 1.82–2.20 µm continuum. Derived from Cassini VIMS; this is not ice percentage, grain size or crystallinity. Colors saturate below 0.30 and above 0.75. One-degree source cells and missing or invalid-continuum cells are retained. The archive has unresolved registration differences at source-pixel scale.
